title: A Bigger Geothermal Bet: What Google’s Fervo Deal Could Mean
title_zh: 更大的地热赌注：谷歌的 Fervo 交易可能意味着什么
summary: Fervo Energy Company (NASDAQ:FRVO) has signed its largest-ever geothermal power agreement with Google, under which it will supply nearly 400 megawatts of electricity from its Cape Station project in southwestern Utah starting in 2028.
summary_zh: Fervo Energy Company（纳斯达克股票代码：FRVO）已与 Google 签署了有史以来最大的地热发电协议，根据该协议，该公司将从 2028 年开始通过位于犹他州西南部的 Cape Station 项目提供近 400 兆瓦的电力。

title: MrBeast Signs Multi-Year Gemini Deal: How Much Is Actually AI?
title_zh: MrBeast 签署多年 Gemini 协议：人工智能到底有多少？
summary: Google and MrBeast sign a multi-year Gemini and Google Health deal, starting with a September 5 survival video.
summary_zh: Google 和 MrBeast 签署了一项为期多年的 Gemini 和 Google Health 协议，从 9 月 5 日的生存视频开始。

title: What Is Fervo Energy (FRVO) Really Gaining From Its 3 GW Geothermal Deal?
title_zh: Fervo Energy (FRVO) 从其 3 GW 地热交易中真正获得了什么？
summary: Fervo Energy (NasdaqGS:FRVO) and Google have signed a new enhanced geothermal framework agreement to support large scale, carbon free data center power. The deal includes what the companies describe as the largest ever geothermal power purchase agreement.
summary_zh: Fervo Energy（纳斯达克GS：FRVO）和谷歌签署了一项新的增强型地热框架协议，以支持大规模、无碳数据中心电力。该交易包括两家公司所说的有史以来最大的地热发电购买协议。

title: HPE Earnings Top Estimates Amid Oracle AI Data Center Deal
title_zh: Oracle AI 数据中心交易中 HPE 盈利预期最高
summary: HPE stock wavered amid fiscal Q3 earnings and revenue that topped estimates with high expectations for AI infrastructure growth.
summary_zh: 由于对人工智能基础设施增长的高预期，第三财季盈利和收入超出预期，HPE 股价出现波动。

title: Waymo taps into debt markets with $3B deal with Pimco, Blackstone - report
title_zh: Waymo 与 Pimco、Blackstone 达成 30 亿美元交易，进军债务市场 - 报告
summary: Investing.com -- Waymo is close to securing its first debt financing, with Pacific Investment Management Co. and other lenders set to provide more than $3 billion to Alphabet Inc.'s autonomous driving unit, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday.
summary_zh: Investing.com——据彭博社周三报道，Waymo 即将获得首笔债务融资，太平洋投资管理公司和其他贷方将向 Alphabet Inc. 的自动驾驶部门提供超过 30 亿美元。
